Source datasets: adhesome_candidates_list.xlsx, interactions.csv, and the supplied earlier interactive hypothesis. Human symbols are mapped conservatively to broad family categories; no reciprocal orthology or parasite interaction was established through that mapping. Grade A/B/C reflects the uploaded audit labels, not physical complex assembly. The Smβ-Int1–ILK–PINCH–Nck2–SmVKR1 branch follows the evidence context cited in the earlier HTML (Gelmedin et al., 2017); its heterologous-assay evidence is not evidence that every family candidate interacts endogenously. Family modules and edges are conceptual rather than measured nanoscale locations. This self-contained HTML operates offline; no data are sent to a server.
